# DNS baseline answer matrix — the oracle for the AdGuard Home migration.
#
# Measured 2026-09-19 from 192.168.120.135 (vlan20) against the NAS Pi-hole at
# 192.168.110.246, with dig +time=3 +tries=1, over both transports.
# Consumed by scripts/dns-parity.sh (3.6) and the Phase 6 acceptance run (6.3).
#
# Columns are TAB-separated: name, qtype, transport, expectation, note
#
# expectation is one of:
#   <address>   the answer set must contain exactly this address, order-free
#   ANY         at least one address record must come back; the value is not
#               compared, because these are load-balanced names that hand out a
#               different edge on every query
#   BLOCKED     the answer must be 0.0.0.0 (Pi-hole's NULL blocking mode today)
#   NXDOMAIN    the name must not resolve
#   NODATA      NOERROR with an empty answer section
#
# A note containing ALLOW-DIFF marks a difference the parity harness may excuse,
# and the note has to say why. Every other row must match.

# --- public names: resolution itself, both transports ---
example.com	A	udp	ANY	load-balanced; Cloudflare hands out a different edge per query
example.com	A	tcp	ANY	the same over TCP — a TCP-only probe passes while UDP is broken
example.com	AAAA	udp	ANY	AAAA still comes from upstream; address=/lan/:: does not touch it
cloudflare.com	A	udp	ANY	second public name, different operator, same load-balancing caveat

# --- blocklist hits: both resolvers must block these, or Gate 3 fails ---
doubleclick.net	A	udp	BLOCKED	StevenBlack list on Pi-hole today; AdGuard must match. A mismatch here is a Gate 3 failure, NOT an allowed difference
doubleclick.net	A	tcp	BLOCKED	the same over TCP — the transport trap for port 53
googleadservices.com	A	udp	BLOCKED	second blocklist hit, different list entry
googlesyndication.com	A	udp	BLOCKED	third blocklist hit

# --- negative controls ---
does-not-exist-zzz.invalid	A	udp	NXDOMAIN	control: a name that must not resolve
nope.lan	A	udp	NODATA	local=/lan/ answers locally, and no rewrite exists for this name

# --- deliberate differences, named rather than waved through ---
ads.doubleclick.net	A	udp	NXDOMAIN	ALLOW-DIFF: upstream NXDOMAIN, not a blocklist hit. AdGuard may answer differently; the row is here to make that visible instead of silent
